```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(stargazer)
library(lmtest)
library(data.table)
library(sandwich)
```
  

```{r}
save_path_data <- "C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/day_ahead/outputs/esp"
setwd(save_path_data)
price_indispo_merge <- read_parquet("price_indispo_merge_esp.parquet")
price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>%
  fill(spot_gas, .direction = "up") %>% 
  rename(renewable_day_ahead_forecast = day_ahead_forecast)



```

```{r}

colnames_with_capacity <- colnames(price_indispo_merge)[grepl("Capacity", colnames(price_indispo_merge))]
#get monthly avg of unavailabilities
capacity_fields <- 
  c(colnames_with_capacity,
    "renewable_day_ahead_forecast",  "unpredicted_renewables", "intraday_update_renewables"
    
    )
price_indispo_merge[colnames_with_capacity] <- lapply(price_indispo_merge[colnames_with_capacity], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))
#
price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000)) %>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity = Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity - Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
              temperature_mismatch = temperature_demand - temperature_supply 
         ) 

price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge[complete.cases(price_indispo_merge),]

price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge[!rowSums(sapply(price_indispo_merge, is.infinite)), ]

price_indispo_merge$weekday <- weekdays(price_indispo_merge$delivery_date)
price_indispo_merge$creneau <- hour(price_indispo_merge$datetime)

colnames(price_indispo_merge)  



#backfill spot gas
price_indispo_merge<- price_indispo_merge %>%
  fill(spot_gas, .direction = "down")


```

On suggère deux hypothèses, soit différence en niveau sur longue période, soit différence immédiate sur des conditions quasi similaires lors de l'activation d'une indispo à deux créneaux proches.

Attention le fait d'avoir pris des heures arrondies à l'heure plien la plus proche peut fausser
les résultats.


On le fait maintenant en niveau



```{r}

m_log_control <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Published.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity+
    #Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity + 
      Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
     Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity +
    #Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    renewable_day_ahead_forecast   +
    gen_tot_da + gen_tot +  gen_tot_da_conso + 
    spot_gas + unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables+
    temperature_demand +
    precipitation_demand + relative_humidity_demand ,
  data= price_indispo_merge)


# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_log_control, type = "HC0")
cl_se_log_control<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster_unavailable  <- vcovCL(m_log_control, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_id)
cl_se_log_unavailable <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
vcov_cluster_nu <- vcovCL(m_log_control, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_nu_id)
cl_se_log_nu <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster_nu))

unavailable_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_control))[grep("Unavailable", names(coefficients(m_log_control)))]
nuclear_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_control))[grep("Nuclear", names(coefficients(m_log_control)))]
cl_se_log_control[unavailable_names] <- cl_se_log_unavailable[unavailable_names]
cl_se_log_control[nuclear_names] <- cl_se_log_nu[nuclear_names]


m_log_FE <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Published.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity+
    #Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity + 
      Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
     Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity +
    #Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    renewable_day_ahead_forecast   +
    gen_tot_da + gen_tot +  gen_tot_da_conso + 
    spot_gas + unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables + 
    temperature_demand +
    precipitation_demand + 
    relative_humidity_demand  +
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+
    + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
  data= price_indispo_merge)


# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_log_FE, type = "HC0")
cl_se_log_FE<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster_unavailable  <- vcovCL(m_log_FE, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_id)
cl_se_log_unavailable <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
vcov_cluster_nu <- vcovCL(m_log_FE, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_nu_id)
cl_se_log_nu <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster_nu))

unavailable_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_FE))[grep("Unavailable", names(coefficients(m_log_FE)))]
nuclear_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_FE))[grep("Nuclear", names(coefficients(m_log_FE)))]
cl_se_log_FE[unavailable_names] <- cl_se_log_unavailable[unavailable_names]
cl_se_log_FE[nuclear_names] <- cl_se_log_nu[nuclear_names]



```



```{r, results = 'asis'}


reg_table <- stargazer( m_log_control ,m_log_FE, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_log_control, cl_se_log_FE),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic",  "Time FE", "+ Controls"),
    keep = c("Capacity","renewable_day_ahead_forecast", 
             "unpredicted_renewables", "intraday_update_renewables")

)
```

```{r}
# perform first stage regression
m_rf <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+  
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + 
    #Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity +
     renewable_day_ahead_forecast   + 
     gen_tot_da + gen_tot +  gen_tot_da_conso +spot_gas+
    unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables+
    temperature_demand +
    precipitation_demand + 
    relative_humidity_demand 
    ,
  data= price_indispo_merge)


vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
cl_se_rf <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# # Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
# vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
# # Erreurs standard clusterisées
# cl_se <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# rf_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_control))[grep("Predicted", names(coefficients(m_log_control)))]
# cl_se_rf[rf_names] <- cl_se[rf_names]


m_rf_FE <- lm(
  log(price) ~  Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+  
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + 
    #Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity +
    renewable_day_ahead_forecast   +
    gen_tot_da + gen_tot +  gen_tot_da_conso +  spot_gas + 
    unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables+
    temperature_demand +
    precipitation_demand + 
    relative_humidity_demand +
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
  data= price_indispo_merge)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf_FE , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_rf_FE <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
```




```{r, results = 'asis'}


reg_table <- stargazer(  m_rf, m_rf_FE,
```

Est ce que les effets sont différenciés aux heures de pointe par rapport aux heures creuses ?



```{r}

price_indispo_merge_offpeak <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  mutate(peak = ifelse(hour(datetime) %in% c(7, 8, 18, 19, 20, 21), 1, 0))

# perform first stage regression


m_log_offpeak <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity*peak + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity*peak+ 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity*peak + 
    # Published.Unavailable.Capacity*peak + Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity*peak +Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity*peak + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity*peak+
    #  Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity*peak +Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity*peak +
    gen_tot_da + gen_tot +  gen_tot_da_conso + renewable_day_ahead_forecast*peak   +
    spot_gas + unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables + 
    temperature_supply +
    precipitation_demand + 
    relative_humidity_demand +
    + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(year) + as.factor(month),
  data= price_indispo_merge_offpeak)

# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_log_offpeak, type = "HC0")
cl_se_log<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster_unavailable  <- vcovCL(m_log_offpeak, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
cl_se_log_unavailable <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
# vcov_cluster_nu <- vcovCL(m_log_offpeak, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_nu_id)
# cl_se_log_nu <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster_nu))

unavailable_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_offpeak))[grep("Unavailable", names(coefficients(m_log_offpeak)))]
#nuclear_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_offpeak))[grep("Nuclear", names(coefficients(m_log_control)))]
cl_se_log[unavailable_names] <- cl_se_log_unavailable[unavailable_names]
# cl_se_log[nuclear_names] <- cl_se_log_nu[nuclear_names]


# Construire une matrice de variance-covariance à partir des erreurs standard
vcov_custom <- diag(cl_se_log^2)
variables_a_retenir <- c("Published.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity",
                         "Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity", "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
                        "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity","Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity"
                         )
# Sélectionner les termes d'interaction contenant '*'
interaction_terms <- grep("\\:", names(coefficients(m_log_offpeak)), value = TRUE)



# Obtenir les résultats complets
coeftest_results <- coeftest(m_log_offpeak, vcov = vcov_custom)

```

```{r, results = 'asis'}
reg_table <- stargazer( m_log_offpeak, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_log),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Time FE", "+ Controls"),
    keep = c("Published.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
    "Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
     "Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity","Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity", 
     "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity", "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity"  ,
    "Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity", "gen_tot",
             "renewable_day_ahead_forecast", "spot_gas", "unpredicted_renewables","unpredicted_renewables_sq", "intraday_update_renewables", interaction_terms,
    "temperature_mismatch", "temperature_supply",
    "precipitation_supply", "precipitation_demand",
    "relative_humidity_supply", "relative_humidity_demand")
)
```

```{r}

m_gen <- lm(

# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
```
